scope: Historical focused source62 checkpoint; no full HLE/DLL linking, hardware execution, audible correction or performance qualification.

implementation.skipParsing: Strict ASCII unsigned decimal; invalid or out-of-range input prevents tracer setup.
implementation.rawPlacement: Immediately before the existing prepareBuffer call, before volume and channel mapping or SDL conversion.
implementation.queuedPlacement: After the existing pacing wait, immediately before SDL_QueueAudio; records the actual converted or directly queued byte span and subsequent SDL return.
implementation.ordinals: Raw and queued rate, channel format, frame/byte/sample ordinals, canonical block phase and clocks are independent. Equal skip values do not align them with native WASAPI or postmix.
implementation.metadata: Port-generation and format metadata, SDL conversion result/size, null drains, queue timeout clears, conversion/queue failures, acceptance results and per-channel FNV fingerprints for up to eight channels.
implementation.poolAllocation: Fixed metadata pool and worker created only with the exact opt-in; no retained PCM or PCM pointers.
implementation.admittedMetadata: 1000 through 384000 Hz, one through eight channels, 8/16/32-bit integer or 32-bit float; raw and queued formats are recorded separately.
implementation.duration: 480000 frames represent ten rendered seconds only at 48000 Hz. Other rates require rate-qualified interpretation and can end at the shared process deadline.
implementation.deadline: Pool initialization plus floor(skip frames / 48000) and 45 wall-clock seconds; late-created ports share that deadline.
implementation.ownership: Port-to-tracer lock ordering is one-way. The worker never enters Port, SDL or the game mutex. Closed, exporting and exported generations reject hooks; exports serialize immutable fixed-pool metadata outside the tracing lock.
implementation.privateExport: Exclusive temporary creation, completed publication without clobbering existing files, and cleanup of owned partial writes. POSIX mode0600, existing-file and symlink controls passed; actual Windows/Wine filesystem behavior remains unqualified.
implementation.behavior: Existing mapping, conversion, queued bytes, pacing waits/timeouts, errors and HLE return paths remain unchanged in the inspected source and deterministic fixture scope.
implementation.fingerprintLimit: FNV equality is not source-byte identity, defect cause or source/native/postmix phase alignment.

focusedValidation.checked: Actual old/new legacy prepareBuffer, queueAudio and Open registration use deterministic SDL, CVT and guest-clock adapters. Checks cover independent aggregate/per-channel byte oracles, canonical blocks across variable calls, unaligned guards, silent/volume/channel paths, limits and concurrent independent streams.
focusedValidation.independentReview: Passed only for restricted bounded diagnostic; conditional unload hazard remains.

restrictedRunContract.cleanup: Force termination of the owned test process after confirmed completed exports and worker closure; no graceful or dynamic DLL-unload acceptance.
restrictedRunContract.conditionalDllDetachHazard: Function-static pool destruction joins its worker during DLL CRT teardown. If the worker is still active under the Windows/Wine loader lock, DLL unload or process detach can hang. General unload and teardown are unqualified; the exact disabled state creates no pool or worker.

publication: Sanitized source metadata, aggregate counts and anonymous artifact hashes only; no captured audio, raw fingerprints, private artifact paths or game data.
